subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue stay canonical for Google Chat Space @mention activation failures after the shipped `spaceType` classifier fix, or should maintainers consolidate it into broader Google Chat Space/thread routing work?
rationale: The classifier defect is fixed, but recent live comments and current source still point to a narrower mentioned-Space activation problem; the remaining work boundary affects whether a fix should target mention identity only or wait for broader Space/thread routing design.

options.title: Keep Narrow Space Mention Bug
options.body: Track and fix mentioned Space events that are accepted by the webhook but dropped by the mention gate, while linking broader thread and all-message work separately.

options.title: Consolidate Into Space/Thread Routing
options.body: Move the remaining evidence into the broader Google Chat Space/thread issue and close this only after maintainer confirmation of the canonical tracking path.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Payload First
options.body: Pause implementation until a current redacted Google Chat event payload shows the exact annotation and config shape that fails with `botUser` set.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Space Mention Bug
recommendation.body: Track and fix mentioned Space events that are accepted by the webhook but dropped by the mention gate, while linking broader thread and all-message work separately.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest recent live PR routing signal for the classifier landing and Google Chat follow-up boundary, while implementation details likely involve the Google Chat plugin contributors listed above.
